product_overview: Streak is a gamified daily quest tracker for students on break, designed to keep users productive through reusable quests, streak-based Bara mechanics, XP progression, and social competition. The backend supports authentication, profile management, quest completion logging, achievements, friends, leaderboards, and streak maintenance.
core_goals: Provide a flexible daily structure through reusable quest templates
Encourage consistent habit-building with streak-based Bara mechanics and XP rewards
Enable social motivation through friends, requests, and leaderboard rankings
Support reliable streak recovery with client-side grace period checks and cron fallback
Deliver a secure, responsive backend foundation for profile, achievements, and progress tracking

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: A root status endpoint used to verify the backend is running and reachable.
user_flows: GET / with no authentication -> Receive 200 with a status string indicating the server is available
GET / with server unavailable or misconfigured -> Receive a network error or non-200 response and show a backend health failure state

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Handles user registration, sign-in, session retrieval, sign-out, and username availability checks.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/sign-up/email with valid name, email, and password -> Receive 200 with created auth object -> GET /api/auth/get-session to confirm session -> Receive 200 with current session object
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with auth object and active session -> GET /api/auth/get-session -> Receive 200 with session details
GET /api/check-username/:username with an available username -> Receive 200 with {available:true} -> Proceed to onboarding username submission
POST /api/auth/sign-up/email with invalid or incomplete fields -> Receive 400 validation error -> User remains on register form and corrects input
POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with invalid credentials -> Receive 400 invalid credentials -> Show login error and keep session unauthenticated
POST /api/auth/sign-out with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with success object -> GET /api/auth/get-session -> Receive empty or unauthenticated session state

features.name: User Profile API
features.description: Fetches and updates the authenticated user's profile, including streak statistics and favorite categories.
user_flows: GET /api/me with a valid auth session -> Receive 200 with profile, streak, XP, and favorite categories data -> Render dashboard/profile summary
PUT /api/me with valid name, unique username, and favorite categories -> Receive 200 with updated profile object -> GET /api/me -> Receive 200 reflecting the new profile values
PUT /api/me with a username that is already taken -> Receive 400 validation error or username already taken -> Keep current profile unchanged and show username conflict state
GET /api/me without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Redirect user to login or show auth required state

features.name: Quests Management API
features.description: Creates, updates, deletes, lists, and completes reusable quest templates while tracking completion history and XP/streak effects.
user_flows: POST /api/quests with a valid title, timeGoalMinutes, and category -> Receive 201 with created quest object -> GET /api/quests -> Receive 200 with the new quest included
GET /api/quests with an authenticated session on a new day -> Receive 200 with active quests and auto-reset completion status for the day -> Display daily quest list

PUT /api/quests/:id with valid updated title, duration, and category -> Receive 200 with updated quest object -> GET /api/quests/:id/history -> Receive 200 with unchanged completion history and updated quest metadata
DELETE /api/quests/:id with a valid quest id -> Receive 200 with {success:true} -> GET /api/quests -> Receive 200 with the quest archived or removed from active list
POST /api/quests/:id/check with an active quest during a normal day -> Receive 200 with completed:true, xpGained, newStreak, and totalXp -> GET /api/me -> Receive 200 with updated streak and XP stats
POST /api/quests/:id/check when the quest id does not exist -> Receive 404 Quest not found -> Show not-found state and do not change progress
GET /api/quests/:id/history with a valid quest id -> Receive 200 with completion log array -> Render quest completion history timeline

features.name: Leaderboard API
features.description: Returns ranked users for global or friends tabs based on streak and XP.
user_flows: GET /api/leaderboard?tab=global with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with global leaderboard data -> Render top-ranked users by current streak and total XP
GET /api/leaderboard?tab=friends with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with friends leaderboard data -> Render ranking among accepted friends only
GET /api/leaderboard without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Show login required state for leaderboard access

features.name: Friends System API
features.description: Supports user search, friend requests, pending request review, request responses, and listing accepted friends.
user_flows: GET /api/friends/search?q=alice with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with matching users -> POST /api/friends/request with targetUserId -> Receive 201 request created -> GET /api/friends/requests on the recipient side -> Receive 200 with incoming pending request -> POST /api/friends/respond with requestId and action=accept -> Receive 200 and mutual friendship is established
GET /api/friends with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with accepted friends list -> Use returned friends data to populate friends leaderboard context
POST /api/friends/request with targetUserId equal to the current user or an already-friended user -> Receive 400 cannot add self or already friends -> Show appropriate friend request error
GET /api/friends/search?q=unknownuser with no matching results -> Receive 200 with empty array -> Show 'Username tidak ditemukan' style empty state
POST /api/friends/respond with an invalid action value -> Receive 400 invalid action -> Keep request pending and show response validation error
GET /api/friends/requests without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Require login before viewing friend requests

features.name: Achievements API
features.description: Returns the authenticated user's unlocked badges and achievements.
user_flows: GET /api/achievements with a valid auth session -> Receive 200 with unlocked achievements array -> Render badges such as Week Warrior, Fortnight Fighter, or Quest Legend
GET /api/achievements without authentication -> Receive 401 Unauthorized -> Show login required state and hide achievement list

features.name: Daily Cron Maintenance API
features.description: Runs a background maintenance job to update streak risk states and expire overdue grace periods.
user_flows: POST /api/cron/daily with no authentication -> Receive 200 with success:true and streaksUpdated count -> Update users whose grace periods expired or who became at risk
POST /api/cron/daily when no streak records need updates -> Receive 200 with success:true and streaksUpdated:0 -> Leave existing streak data unchanged
